articles.title: Max Verstappen Spent 40 Hours Playing GTA 6 and Still Won the Las Vegas Grand Prix
articles.summary: Famous Dutch-Belgian race driver Max Verstappen revealed that he’d spent the weekend of the Las Vegas Grand Prix locked in to GTA 6, saying he played over 40 hours of the game. Everyone’s got GTA 6 fever, including Max Verstappen.
body: Verstappen nonchalantly dropped this nugget of information during a live stream the following week, saying he would play the game in the mornings and evenings in between his duties on the track.
“I played a lot in the evening and in the morning in Vegas,” Verstappen explained. “I mean, I can’t go out anyways and walk around.”
The driver also revealed that he’s been so focused on GTA 6 and driving real-life race cars that he’s “completely forgotten” how to play Minecraft, despite having a scheduled stream for it.
“I’m so bad when I play too many games at the same time. I can’t, I just can’t!” he joked.

articles.title: Call Of Duty’s 19-Year Sales Streak Continues
articles.summary: Circana has released its latest monthly sales report for the US video game industry, and in terms of game sales, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 led the way. It was the No.
body: It was the No. 1 best-selling game of October 2026, and that's notable because it marked the 19th consecutive year that a new Call of Duty game has been the top-selling title for its launch month.
This streak began in November 2008 when Call of Duty: World at War beat out Guitar Hero: World Tour and Gears of War 2 to rank No. 1.

Circana also announced that spending on content for consoles dropped by 18% compared to October 2026. It was always going to be a tough comparison, though, as October 2025 saw the releases of Battlefield 6 and Pokemon Legends Z-A.

Looking ahead to November 2026, Rockstar's GTA 6 is no doubt going to rank No. 1 for the month and it's sure to finish 2026 as the best-selling game overall. It's already selling at a blistering pace, after all.

articles.title: Black Friday Streaming Deals: Everything You Need to Know Before You Subscribe
articles.summary: Pretty much every service (other than good ol' Netflix) has announced a Black Friday deal for 2026, offering a rare respite from the onslaught of price hikes.
body: Streaming prices have been going up for years now, with no sign they'll ever come back down. To make matters worse, streaming deals have become increasingly rare, and there's really only one time of year when services offer a discount.

These deals are by far the best way to try out a new service or lock down your favorites for their cheapest price of the year, but some services are being more generous than others. A few are even offering 12-month deals that cover you until the next round of Black Friday discounts.

Scroll on for a deeper breakdown of our top picks, but the TL;DR is that Disney+ and Hulu are offering the only bundle deal of the year, while Apple TV, Paramount+, and Crunchyroll are splurging with discounts on ad-free plans. Peacock decided to bring back its Black Friday deal after skipping the festivities in 2025, but Netflix is still completely MIA and likely always will be.

Disney+ and Hulu have brought back the exact same Black Friday deal they offered in 2025. The Basic bundle with ads is down to $4.99/month for a 12-month period. However, after another round of Disney+ price hikes, the deal technically offers better savings than last year.

articles.title: Some GTA 6 Fans Love Chapter 1 for Its Slower Pace and Are Spending Dozens of Hours Roleplaying in It
articles.summary: GTA 6's first chapter has been somewhat divisive due to its slower pace, but it's also a part of the game that some fans have spent dozens of hours playing due to it highly immersive slice-of-life elements.
body: Warning: This article features light spoilers for the early hours of GTA 6.

Instead of throwing you headfirst into crazy heists or explosive set pieces, the first chapter of GTA 6 is largely spent bumbling around Rockstar's version of the Florida Keys. You can go fishing, scuba diving, and even fix up your house before Lucia's release from prison. It's an exceptionally low-key and chill opening to a game filled with all kinds of crazy action, which is why it's also rubbed some people the wrong way. They don't want to do chores or kick it on the beach; they want to cause some mayhem.

However, for others, this has become an unexpected hook for GTA 6 that actually delayed their interest in getting to the meat of Rockstar's open-world epic. Various fans of the game have said they spent anywhere from 10 to as many as 40+ hours in just Chapter 1 alone. Keep in mind, this is a sliver of the overall experience, and much of the game's most interesting activities don't get added until subsequent chapters. However, some players just enjoyed living inside of this part of the game before things go horribly wrong and they're forced to start ramping up the violence and crime.
points: GTA 6's first chapter has been somewhat divisive due to its slower pace, but it's also a part of the game that some fans have spent dozens of hours playing due to it highly immersive slice-of-life…

articles.title: Just Like GTA 6, The Witcher 4 Has A PlayStation Deal
articles.summary: CD Projekt Red has announced that just today, November 24, the Polish studio signed new deals with Sony Interactive Entertainment for The Witcher 4 's upcoming marketing campaign, among other efforts.
body: CFO Piotr Nielubowicz told investors that the deals cover CD Projekt Red's games on PlayStation and in the PlayStation Plus catalog, as well as "our collaboration during the upcoming Witcher 4 marketing campaign."
“This cooperation will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years," he said, according to VGC.
No specifics were made available, but the partnership for The Witcher 4's marketing campaign has people theorizing that it could be similar to Rockstar's co-marketing deal with Sony for GTA 6.

Under that agreement, GTA 6 was marketed as a game that "plays best on PS5," even if the jury is out on that being true. Sony also created special GTA 6 DualSense controllers and even custom consoles for NBA players. The PlayStation branding was prioritized over Xbox to give people the impression that they should get it on PlayStation.

articles.title: GTA 6's Most Heartbreaking Scene Is Exactly Why You Had To Do All Those Chores
articles.summary: Jason repairs the steps leading up to his and Lucia’s home, fixes a railing, buys groceries, orders flowers, paints the walls of their bedroom, and more to prepare for Lucia’s arrival from prison.
body: Grand Theft Auto 6 features as much shootin’, stealin’, and drug runnin’ as you’d expect from the latest entry in a series named after a felony. However, some players have been caught off-guard by just how much the early game is all about the more mundane parts of life. Namely, you gotta do a bunch of chores around the house. In many ways, GTA 6 is as much of an everyday life sim as it is a game about committing crimes.

Chapter 1 involves Jason and Lucia trying to get work from Mattia, the shady boyfriend of Kat, a mother-to-be whom Lucia befriended in prison. Part of that involves a standout sequence set to a Carly Rae Jepsen banger before Lucia gets lost in orgy central. (Vice City, y’all!) Bro, Mattia promises a job that could pay ten grand, bro. They just have to grab a bag from a locker and deliver it, bro.

Red flags abound, but Jason and Lucia go along for the ride, which quickly results in their arrest. Crooked cops show up, the couple gets into a shootout, and Jason gets grievously wounded while the couple struggle to keep hold over a bag containing who knows what.

articles.title: WoW: Forever’s Best Buffs Now Work As Intended
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever players will now be able to get even more benefit from the game's strongest buffs, as developer Blizzard's latest hotfix has made World Buffs persist across loading screens as intended.
body: World Buffs are powerful stat-boosting effects granted to players in a particular area for certain events. The most common World Buff players see is Warchief's Blessing on the Horde and the new Might of Stormwind for the Alliance, which are granted to all players in Orgrimmar, Stormwind, and their surrounding low-level zones when players on their respective faction turn in a specific high-level quest.

Now that players are reaching endgame and turning in the required quest, these buffs are popping off constantly. They grant a whopping 300 hit points, 15% melee haste, and 10 mana regen per five seconds for one hour. At lower levels, those are some serious stats, particularly the 300 HP.

Unfortunately, players haven't been able to take full advantage of the buffs, as a bug was causing them to be lost when hitting a loading screen. That meant any time a group stepped into a dungeon or took a boat or zeppelin to a new location, their World Buffs would be removed.
points: World of Warcraft: Forever players will now be able to get even more benefit from the game's strongest buffs, as developer Blizzard's latest hotfix has made World Buffs persist across loading screens…

articles.title: How to flip your car in GTA 6
articles.summary: Flipping your car in Grand Theft Auto 6 works a bit differently than it did in previous games. In Rockstar's bid for realism, the team made it so you can't flip your car while you're still in it. Instead, whichever character you're controlling will have to get out of the car and turn it over.
body: If you manage to turn over your sedan, ATV, boat, or cement truck, and you do it without getting wasted ( GTA 6 's term for "destroying it completely and dying"), you might think you'll have to get Scooter Bros to deliver the vehicle for you. Well, you don't. Keep that hard-stolen cash in your BuckMe account and fix it yourself.
And you're good to go on your merry way. That said, there are a few caveats to bear in mind if you're trying to flip your car.

Try to push the car from the middle. If you're at either end of it, we noticed the prompt tends not to appear. Also, if there's an obstacle on the other side of the car, like a thick hedge or a wall, you won't be able to flip it. The same is true for when your car is just stuck on something, like a guardrail. The game won't let you flip it off the offending object, as it has to be completely upended for the "shove" prompt to appear.
points: Flipping your car in Grand Theft Auto 6 works a bit differently than it did in previous games.
In Rockstar's bid for realism, the team made it so you can't flip your car while you're still in it.
Instead, whichever character you're controlling will have to get out of the car and turn it over.
That said, there are a few caveats to bear in mind if you're trying to flip your car.

articles.title: Vice City portal Easter egg location in GTA 6
articles.summary: The Vice City portal Easter egg is a unique event in Grand Theft Auto 6 that lets you travel through time. It might not look like it, but the existence of a secret portal in Leonida is quite plausible, considering the UFOs appearing in the skies and the forgotten haunted hotels you can visit.
body: To experience this event and open the portal, you will have to complete a long series of steps. But don't worry, below, we explain everything you need to know to complete the Vice City portal Easter egg in GTA 6.

If you want to start the Vice City portal event in GTA 6, you must travel to Key Lento, the initial area in the game, and head to the Badger radio tower, northeast of the Nifty Threads Island Wear shop. Enter the tower and climb to the top to reach what appears to be a control room.

Beside the door, there's a lever. Pull it up then press the button on the panel near the old television. If you've done everything correctly, the TV will turn on and display the word "Malibu." Now, leave the tower and prepare for the next step.

articles.title: The Steam Awards turn 10 with throwback categories and a Game of the Year Hall of Fame
articles.summary: Nominations for the 2026 Steam Awards are now open, and to mark the event's 10th anniversary, Valve has brought back some categories from years past and added a Hall of Fame.
body: You've got until 6pm UK (10am Pacific) on 30th November to nominate your favourite games of the year across 14 categories. Returning throwbacks include Just 5 More Minutes, Defies Description, and This is My Job Now, which recognises games that simulate mundane real-life jobs.
The new Hall of Fame category will appear when voting opens, and will let players choose their favourite from Steam's previous Game of the Year winners to crown the best game of the past decade.
Most categories are only open to games released on Steam since last year's Autumn Sale.

The exception is the Labo(u)r of Love award, which goes to older games that developers are still supporting with new content. Previous Labo(u)r of Love winners, including Warframe, Grand Theft Auto 5, Cyberpunk 2077, and Baldur's Gate 3, can't be nominated again.

articles.title: How to get your car out of the impound in GTA 6
articles.summary: It doesn't take long for one of your cars to end up at the police impound in Grand Theft Auto 6. You might have abandoned it near a crime scene, or they arrested you while you were driving it.
body: If you are not ready to abandon your favorite car and want it back, we've got you covered. Here's how to get your car out of the impound in GTA 6.
There are two methods to retrieve a car from the police impound: you can either steal it back or pay for it. Both are valid, but the second one becomes available only in Chapter 2.

Stealing the car is the most plausible and cheapest option to execute. You just need to head to the impound lot, enter, and drive your car away from there. Some impounds, like the one in Port Gellhorn, have openings that you can use to enter unnoticed. Regardless of how you get inside, the challenge is escaping from the police once you leave. You must be prepared to run away, so try to come up with an escape route by setting a destination far from the city.

Now, the second option requires the Scooter Bros app, which you unlock in Chapter 2 after completing Moses' mission. If you have it already, open the app and select the impounded car (the one with a police badge icon). You will see that the first option in the menu is to pay a fee to retrieve the car.

articles.title: You can expect a similar leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 as there is between GTA 5 and GTA 6, CD Projekt Red says
articles.summary: CD Projekt Red has said people can expect a similar qualitative and technological leap from The Witcher 3 to The Witcher 4 as has been witnessed between Grand Theft Auto 5 and Grand Theft Auto 6.
body: CDPR joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski made the remark during a Q3 earnings call this afternoon, during which he and CDPR faced a handful of questions related to GTA 6.

"First of all, obviously this is a call about us, not about Rockstar," Nowakowski began by saying, "but I do understand the connection here. Having said that, I'm not going to make a deep-dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course we did look at the game, we did see the differences.

"We believe there's going to be a comparable leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 - I think so, yes. It's been 11 years, we are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game, so yes you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4."

Another question was about whether GTA 6 had affected development plans for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2 - a question well-timed after Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski joked at the weekend that "Cyberpunk 2 is cancelled" because of how impressive GTA 6 is.
points: CD Projekt Red has said people can expect a similar qualitative and technological leap from The Witcher 3 to The Witcher 4 as has been witnessed between Grand Theft Auto 5 and Grand Theft Auto 6.

articles.title: GTA 6 launch knocked Call of Duty's daily players down 42 percent, Alinea estimates
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 's launch took a big bite out of Call of Duty’s player base, according to new estimates from Alinea Analytics, and four days on, it still hasn't recovered.
body: "Sadly, CoD has barely bounced back after four days," Elliott wrote. "It's still down 41% from its baseline."

Fortnite and FC 27 took a hit too, but both are already recovering. Fortnite's DAUs on PlayStation and Xbox fell 28 percent, from 17.8 million to 12.8 million, but by the end of the weekend it had clawed its way back to 19 percent below its baseline.
Epic is also holding a live event to close out the current season on 5th December, which Elliott says the studio "hopes will pull players back after they’ve polished off GTA 6’s story".
FC 27's DAUs dropped by around 27 percent, from 5.9 million to 4.3 million, and it's already back within 20 percent of its baseline.
